(1) the Phanerozoice consists of three mutually distinct climate states, (2) the default climate state is Greenhouse, (3) the Greenhouse state must be forced to become the Hothouse state, and (4) the HEATT mechanism is one such forcing mechanism.
the Phanerozic consists of 3 mutually exclusive climate states, and that 16 Phanerzoic mass extictions were forced by LIPs via the HEATT mechanism.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between climate, ocean chemistry, and mass extinction.
the development of the HEATT mechanism, which is the primary mechanism that forces Greenhouse climate into Hothouse climate and produces Phanerozo mass extinctions.
the relationship of LIPs, HEATT episodes, and mass extinction.

11 of the 23 mass extinctions of Phanerozoan eukaryotic life are linked to HEATT episodes.
of the 23 Phanerozo mass extinctions, 16 are likely related to HEATT episodes, 4 to ice-volume-related regresssions, and 2 are problematic.
